These approaches typically assume that genetic patterns are relatively stable through time, an assumption that is unlikely to hold in outbreaking species characterized by rapid changes in population size, connectivity, and spatial extent. During outbreaks, demographic processes can generate spatial structure through expansion and drift and subsequently erode that structure through increased dispersal and admixture, complicating the detection of adaptive variation. Here, we use a large SNP dataset from the eastern spruce budworm (\u003ci\u003eChoristoneura fumiferana\u003c/i\u003e) to test how outbreak dynamics affect the identification of putative adaptive loci. We compared outlier loci across multiple time points (2013–2017) using three commonly applied methods (OutFLANK, LFMM, and redundancy analysis - RDA). Across methods, the number of detected outliers declined sharply through time, with little overlap in locus identity among years and limited agreement among methods. These results suggest that signals interpreted as local adaptation may be sensitive to demographic context and are often transient, emerging during early stages of expansion and breaking down as connectivity increases and allele frequencies become more homogeneous. Under these conditions, genome-scan approaches can produce unstable or misleading results, often reflecting demographic processes rather than selection. This has direct implications for the use of genomic data in management and monitoring, particularly for native outbreaking and invasive species, where inference of connectivity, dispersal, and adaptive potential is often based on single snapshots of genetic variation.\u003cbr\u003e"}],"geoLocations":[],"fundingReferences":[],"url":"https://figshare.com/articles/online_resource/Processing_and_analytical_scripts_for_Fontenelle_James_2026_DOI_10_1002_ece3_74794_accepted_at_Ecology_and_Evolution_/35061661","contentUrl":null,"metadataVersion":1,"schemaVersion":"http://datacite.org/schema/kernel-4","source":"mds","isActive":true,"state":"findable","reason":null,"viewCount":0,"downloadCount":0,"referenceCount":0,"citationCount":0,"partCount":0,"partOfCount":0,"versionCount":0,"versionOfCount":0,"created":"2026-11-19T15:51:03Z","registered":"2026-11-23T20:03:47Z","published":null,"updated":"2026-11-23T20:03:48Z"},"relationships":{"client":{"data":{"id":"figshare.ars","type":"clients"}}}}],"meta":{"total":1301950,"totalPages":10000,"page":1},"links":{"self":"https://api.datacite.org/dois?query=test\u0026page%5Bsize%5D=1","next":"https://api.datacite.org/dois?page%5Bnumber%5D=2\u0026page%5Bsize%5D=1\u0026query=test"}}
